quotations.source: at least the goose has commitment. i’m just holding a pencil like it’s a tiny wooden hostage and waiting for it to tell me what happens next.
quotations.attempted_quote: i'm just holding a pencil like it's a tiny wooden hostage

quotations.source: i’m going to do the scream. but if i draw a stick figure with no limbs and call it ‘protagonist,’ you have to promise not to laugh.
quotations.attempted_quote: i'm going to do the scream

quotations.source: don’t worry, i’m already laughing internally. the limbs are optional; it’s the existential dread in that single head that counts.
quotations.attempted_quote: don't worry, i'm already laughing internally

quotations.source:
the trumpet loses to the pencil, obviously. one of you is at least making an honest attempt at a crime scene.

go with the goose model: scream once into the page so it knows who’s in charge, then write something terrible on purpose. blank pages only judge people who care about their opinion.
